{"text": "The `_apply_single_annotation` function is a method within the `GenerateSchema` class.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `_apply_single_annotation` function processes metadata for a given schema in Pydantic's internal schema generation process.", "type": "intent"},
{"text": "The `_apply_single_annotation` function takes a parameter `schema`, which is a dictionary representing the core schema.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `_apply_single_annotation` function takes a parameter `metadata`, which can be any type but is typically an instance of `FieldInfo`.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "If the metadata is an instance of `FieldInfo`, the `_apply_single_annotation` function iterates over its internal metadata and recursively applies each piece.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `_apply_single_annotation` function checks for a discriminator in the `FieldInfo` and applies it to the schema if present.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "For nullable schemas, the `_apply_single_annotation` function applies the metadata to the inner schema instead.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "If the schema has a reference (`ref`) or is a definition reference, the `_apply_single_annotation` function creates a new reference string incorporating the metadata's representation and updates the schema accordingly.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The `_apply_single_annotation` function relies on `import_cached_field_info` to import necessary classes and `_known_annotated_metadata.apply_known_metadata` to apply specific types of known metadata.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `_apply_single_annotation` function returns the original schema when the updated schema is not modified.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The `_apply_single_annotation` function does not raise exceptions and may return early when a new reference already exists in the definitions.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `_apply_single_annotation` function modifies the schema dictionary in place and may add new entries to the `defs.definitions` dictionary when new references are created.", "type": "behavioural"}
]
